name: ZSF_FCST_ADJUSTMENT
description: This table has the adjustments for each territory participant in forecasting application

columns.name: FCST_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for the adjustment table, there is one adjustment record for every participant for each adjustment period

columns.name: FCST_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: FK to ZSF_FCST_PARTICIPANT.PARTICIPANT_ID, the participant to which the adjustment belongs to.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_BY_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Participant id making summary level adjustment. This is to differentiate a manager adjusting subordinate

columns.name: LAST_ADJUSTED_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Participant Id of the person who made the last adjustment.

columns.name: LAST_ADJUSTED_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Resource Id of the person who made the last adjustment for this participant

columns.name: LAST_ADJUSTED_DATE
columns.description: Last Adjusted date . This is stored for adjustment history purpose

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON
columns.description: Reason entered for the summary adjustment . Entered in the UI

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_COMMENT
columns.description: Comments entered for the summary adjustment . Entered in the UI

columns.name: CURR_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: This has the currency exchange rate considered for the adjustment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
